title: My schedule and exchanges
description: Review your exchange history and request a swap using the exact published shifts. No schedule changes until the other employee accepts and an independent manager approves.
loadError: Unable to load shift exchanges. Try again.
empty: You have no exchange requests for this filter.
saveError: Unable to update the exchange. Review the current schedule and try again.

create.title: Request a shift exchange
create.description: Choose one of your future shifts and one available coworker shift. Both versions are frozen for review; the server will reject the request if either shift changes.
create.noOwnShifts: You have no future, active and unclaimed shifts available.
create.noCandidates: No eligible coworker shifts are available for this selection.
create.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why you are requesting this exchange
create.acknowledge: I reviewed these exact two shifts and understand that this only creates a request.

decision.acknowledgeExactPair: I reviewed these exact two shifts and consent to this decision.
decision.reasonHint: Enter between 10 and 500 characters. Only participants and authorized management can open this history.

accepted.title: Accept this exact exchange
accepted.description: Acceptance records your consent but does not modify either schedule. An independent manager or administrator must still approve it.

approved.title: Approve this exact exchange
approved.description: Approval revalidates both assignments and replaces them atomically. Do not approve an exchange in which you participate.

rejected.title: Reject this exchange
rejected.description: The request will close without changing either schedule. Record the operational reason.

cancelled.title: Cancel this exchange
cancelled.description: The request or your prior acceptance will be withdrawn without changing either schedule.

history.title: Private exchange history
history.loadError: Unable to load the private exchange history.

manager.title: Shift exchange approvals
manager.description: Review the frozen assignments. Approval is available only after the other employee accepts and never when you participate in the exchange.
manager.forbidden: Only managers and administrators can review team exchanges.
manager.empty: There are no exchanges awaiting management review.
manager.waitingConsent: Waiting for the other employee's explicit acceptance. Management may reject, but cannot approve yet.
